english.title: Promoter attempt to induce payment into or participation in unfair trading scheme
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a

(A)_[promoter of]_
(B)_[person acting in accordance with]_

a trading scheme to which Part XI of the Fair Trading Act 1973 Act applies, or any other such trading scheme, by holding out to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), the prospect of receiving payments or other benefits in respect of the introduction of other persons who become participants in the trading scheme, attempted to induce

(C)_[him to make a payment to or for the benefit of the promoter or any of the promoters or to or for the benefit of a participant in the trading scheme of which he was already a participant]_
(D)_[her to make a payment to or for the benefit of the promoter or any of the promoters or to or for the benefit of a participant in the trading scheme of which she was already a participant]_
(E)_[him to become a participant in the trading scheme and to make a payment to or for the benefit of the promoter or any of the promoters or to or for the benefit of a participant in the trading scheme]_
(F)_[her to become a participant in the trading scheme and to make a payment to or for the benefit of the promoter or any of the promoters or to or for the benefit of a participant in the trading scheme]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 120(4) and 122 of the Fair Trading Act 1973.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being promoter of trading scheme to which Part XI of the Fair Trading Act 1973 applied OR
person acting in accordance with such a trading scheme
by holding out to any person such a prospect as is mentioned in section 120(3)(b) of that Act
attempts to induce person if he is already a participant in the trading scheme
to make any payment to / for the benefit of promoters to / for the benefit of a participant in the trading scheme / if he is not already a participant in the trading scheme
to become such a participant and to make any such payment

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the prescribed sum.

Indictment: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 129 of the Fair Trading Act 1973

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
